Create a document with a nonempty title and literal body text.

        body may be empty. folder is an optional nonempty organizational label;
        omit it to use 'default'. A new label is allowed. Markdown and plain text

        its unique id, mock URL, title, body, and folder.

        For formatted lists, use CommonMark Markdown with -, *, or + bullet
        markers. Word limits count whitespace-separated visible text, excluding
        formatting markers and link destinations.

arguments.title: January 2026 Operating Close — Board Framing
arguments.body: January closed with Evergreen at 241 monthly active developers, handled under the standard Growth overage terms—not a custom cap, admin package, or expansion commitment. AWS spend remained below December’s support-spike run rate, while Pinecone continued as monthly usage. The board framing is standard-term retention and margin discipline, with durable owner lanes; this is operating hygiene, not a growth-at-any-cost or financing-efficiency story.

document.body: January closed with Evergreen at 241 monthly active developers, handled under the standard Growth overage terms—not a custom cap, admin package, or expansion commitment. AWS spend remained below December’s support-spike run rate, while Pinecone continued as monthly usage. The board framing is standard-term retention and margin discipline, with durable owner lanes; this is operating hygiene, not a growth-at-any-cost or financing-efficiency story.
